caseNameFull: Edward B. Pryor and Edward F. Kearney, Receivers of the Wabash Railroad Company, in Error v. Laura Christy, Administratrix of the Estate of Edward F. Christy
summary: In error to the Kansas City Court of Appeals of the State of Missouri.
attorneys: Mr. James L. Minnis for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Bruce Barnett for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
